Paseo Quilín

Mid-sized mall in the Macul district, with good metro line 4 connectivity. Practical for neighbourhood shopping, services and fast food for those moving through the south-eastern area.

Best for

  • Quilín area
  • Metro L4 connection
  • Practical shopping

Not ideal for

  • Tourists without metro L4 or a car
  • Those looking for international brands

Getting there

Close to Quilín station, Line 4.

Recommended time: 1–2 hours
